title: Bowers & Wilkins sound system impressions
summary: Feedback on the G70 sound system centers on strong praise for audio quality alongside a smaller set of complaints about noise, rattling, weak speaker performance, and bass loss, with many excerpts too brief or ambiguously coded to interpret confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the Bowers & Wilkins or vehicle sound system for great, excellent, and high-quality audio performance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the sound system as noisy, rattling at higher bass levels, underperforming through the speakers, or not meeting expectations for the vehicle.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention the sound system favorably or note bass changes, but the sample is too ambiguous or inconsistently coded to summarize more confidently.

limitations: Many topic examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confident interpretation of overall customer stance.
The sampled excerpts are brief and may omit context such as listening conditions, comparison points, or whether comments refer to the system generally or to a specific component.
Some undetermined fragments contain apparently positive wording, so coding ambiguity limits how precisely the sample can be summarized.
